SikaRapid®-4 is a set accelerator for concrete and mortar containing added chloride.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.l: SikaRapid®-4 is recommended for use in premix and precast concrete where accelerated setting times are required. As a result, SikaRapid®-4 allows:
s: Faster finishing of concrete surfaces.
Improved early strength of premixed concrete.
Rapid slip-form movement.

cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Product Information > Dispensing
cl.x: SikaRapid®-4 is added to batching water or is poured into the concrete mix at the same time as the gauging water. SikaRapid®-4 may also be added into the premix truck on site. In this case, the concrete should then be mixed for an extra 1 minute for every cubic metre of concrete. The concrete should then be checked visually for uniform consistency before discharging.

cl.c: Data sheet pages 1-2: Product Information > Compatibility
cl.x: SikaRapid®-4 can be used in conjunction with any non-retarded Sika plasticiser or superplasticiser. It is beneficial to add the SikaRapid®-4 with the initial mixing water before the addition of superplasticiser to enhance strength development. Tests must be carried out to determine the optimum combination. Do not use SikaRapid®-4 in conjunction with shrinkage compensating admix-; tures.
Where concrete with low cement content is being supplied, higher dosage rates should be used.
A dose of 4.6L/m³ will give up to 0.4kg/m³ chloride ion for concrete containing reinforcement or other items requiring protection the maximum permitted chloride content is 0.8kg/m³ (AS1379)
Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
